label: circle
answer_line: A single thin white ring (circle outline, about 1 pixel thick) on a black background. Its diameter is about 7–9 pixels. It sits roughly in the middle of the 12 × 12 grid, with its centre shifting by a pixel or so between images. The inside of the ring and the border are black.

label: square
answer_line: Each image is a single white, hollow, axis-aligned rectangle (box outline) with 1-pixel-thick lines on a black background. The box is fairly large, roughly 6–10 pixels on a side. Its position and size vary from image to image, but it always sits inside the black outer border (row/column 0 and 11 almost never lit). The interior of the box is black.

label: triangle
answer_line: Each sample is a white, one-pixel-wide outline of a triangle with its point at the top, on a black background.
